tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold, sampled from the wordmark. Headings, location banners, comp figures, labels, icons, the tagline. Never #F8C000, an older and duller value.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Background of every Clarity surface. Clarity artwork is always gold on near-black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles and panels sitting on ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders, 1 to 2px. Visible but not loud.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on ground or surface.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Logos, names under headshots, value pills.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Footers, captions, secondary copy, tags such as 'Reports to this role'. 5:1 on ground.

tokens.name: gold-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of an emphasis box, such as the compensation panel.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Slide heading, gold, top-left at the top margin.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: Big number in a stat tile, gold.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.sample: Apera is hiring a Chief Revenue Officer.
styles.usage: Lead-in line under a heading, gold or text.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Reports to the founder and CEO.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Gold label in front of a description.

styles.name: slide-caption
styles.usage: Stat labels, job titles under headshots, footers. Never smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a name and its title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between icon and title.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between heading and body.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Slide margins on the 1920 x 1080 canvas.
